question: In which sources and by whom was this teaching authoritatively proclaimed?
premises: The śrīkrama is named as a source.
The great tantra is named as a source.
Śiva is named as the proclaimer.
inference: This teaching was proclaimed by Śiva in the śrīkrama and in the great tantra.
plain_english: It was proclaimed by Śiva in the śrīkrama and in the great tantra.
